examples.en: Contrarily to the nested loop join, indexes are no longer so important.

examples.en: Man might think that few women fit him before his marriage, and contrarily when they get married.
examples.zh: 男人在结婚前觉得适合自己的女人很少，结婚后觉得适合自己的女人很多。
